headline: Ukraine targets Crimean bridge and logistics routes to disrupt Russian supply
summary: Ukrainian strikes damaged key bridge crossings in occupied territories, including the Crimean bridge, following 109 prior Russian strikes against Ukrainian bridge infrastructure.
why: The Crimean Bridge is a strategic rail and road link for military transport and commerce into southern Ukraine.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Disruption of military transportation routes alters regional war logistics.
